test_title: PYST 24: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 26 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
If 'K × L' means 'K is the son of L'.

If ‘K + L' means 'K is the daughter of L'.

If 'K ÷ L' means 'K is the sister of L'.

If ‘K - L' means 'K is the wife of L'.

How is P related to M in the expression 'M ÷ N × O - P'?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Daughter
 Wife 
 Son 
 Sister 
 
 

 

Given: M ÷ N × O - P

It means: M is the sister of M, N is the son of O and O is the wife of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/594ae7701fcaf3f7113b669c630de036ee27f2e24b1c795cad86031e3d95392b.png] 

So, P is the 'Father' of M.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
